technique_name: Construct a tweet summarizing the following news article.
description: Amidst a new NOAA report, the grim reality of climate change is becoming more evident. Scientists have found that increasing concentrations of greenhouse gases have accelerated the effects of droughts, floods, and wildfires. #ClimateChange #GlobalWarming
example: A new report by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration has found that the climate is changing significantly faster than predicted by scientists. The report states that increasing concentrations of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere are causing more severe droughts, floods, and wildfires.
